summary_en: 1,100,000 shares (5.09% of shares outstanding), ¥1.5B upper limit, open-market purchase, Aug 6–Dec 30, 2026. Concurrent cancellation of 4,000,000 shares (15.33% of pre-cancel issued total) effective Sep 18, 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding decision on acquisition of treasury shares and cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 5 August 2026, TOYO Corporation's board resolved to acquire treasury shares and cancel existing treasury shares, both under the Companies Act. The acquisition programme authorizes purchase of up to 1,100,000 shares (5.09% of shares outstanding, computed as 1,100,000 ÷ 21,608,783) for an aggregate ¥1.5 billion maximum via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from 6 August to 30 December 2026. Concurrently, the board resolved to cancel 4,000,000 shares held in treasury, reducing outstanding shares from 26,085,000 to 22,085,000 (effective 18 September 2026). The company cites capital efficiency, enhanced shareholder returns, and reduction of future dilution concerns as the rationale.
